brand_voice.target_audience: Athletes, fitness professionals, and high performers aged 22-45

aesthetic_direction.style: Cinematic editorial athletic photography, bold graphic overlays, high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting, minimalist typography
aesthetic_direction.composition: Strong geometric framing, rule of thirds, clean negative space for typography
aesthetic_direction.negative_constraints: No cartoonish styles, no cluttered gradients, no blurry distorted anatomy, no generic royalty-free stock looks

instagram.caption_structure:
1. Disruptive Hook
2. 2-3 Sentences Value/Story
3. Clear CTA
4. 8-12 Hyper-targeted Hashtags

facebook.caption_structure: Story-driven, direct community question at the end.
